```{python}
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap

components = [f"comp{i}" for i in range(1, 19)]

Combined_dataset[components] = Combined_dataset[components].apply(
    pd.to_numeric,
    errors="coerce"
)


# ============================================================
# 1. RAW COMPONENT HEATMAP
# ============================================================

heatmap_data = (
    Combined_dataset
    .groupby("Dataset_name")[components]
    .median()
)

cmap = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
    "steelblue_sandybrown",
    ["steelblue", "lightblue", "wheat", "sandybrown"]
)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(180 * MM, 100 * MM))

im = ax.imshow(
    heatmap_data.values,
    aspect="auto",
    cmap=cmap
)

ax.set_xticks(range(len(components)))
ax.set_xticklabels(
    components,
    rotation=45,
    ha="right"
)

ax.set_yticks(range(len(heatmap_data.index)))
ax.set_yticklabels(heatmap_data.index)

ax.set_xlabel("Component")
ax.set_ylabel("Dataset")
ax.set_title("Median component value per dataset")

cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax)
cbar.set_label("Median value")

plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(
    fig_dir / "component_heatmap.svg",
    format="svg",
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()


# ============================================================
# 2. STANDARDIZED COMPONENT HEATMAP
# ============================================================

heatmap_z = heatmap_data.sub(
    heatmap_data.mean(axis=1),
    axis=0
)

heatmap_z = heatmap_z.div(
    heatmap_data.std(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan),
    axis=0
)

limit = np.nanmax(np.abs(heatmap_z.values))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(180 * MM, 100 * MM))

im = ax.imshow(
    heatmap_z.values,
    aspect="auto",
    cmap=cmap,
    vmin=-limit,
    vmax=limit
)

ax.set_xticks(range(len(components)))
ax.set_xticklabels(
    components,
    rotation=45,
    ha="right"
)

ax.set_yticks(range(len(heatmap_z.index)))
ax.set_yticklabels(heatmap_z.index)

ax.set_xlabel("Component")
ax.set_ylabel("Dataset")
ax.set_title("Relative component pattern per dataset")

cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax)
cbar.set_label("Z-score")

plt.tight_layout()

plt.savefig(
    fig_dir / "component_heatmap_zscore.svg",
    format="svg",
    bbox_inches="tight"
)

plt.show()
```
